referencePolicy.sourcePriority: Current official PhiladelphiaEagles.com player roster/headshot page
referencePolicy.visualRule: Artists/generators must inspect the cited current official headshot before rendering. Never infer skin tone, hair, facial hair, facial features, or other visible appearance from a player's name, biography, position, nickname, heritage, or stale asset.
referencePolicy.style: realistic 3D chibi; adult football proportions; recognizable at Gamecast scale

render.camera: three-quarter front; match approved Dallas production camera
render.lighting: soft stadium key plus cool rim; match approved Dallas production lighting
render.numberAccuracy: required; re-check official roster before final render

verification.auditNote: A uniqueness audit of appearance-reference-01 through appearance-reference-05 found four repeated player entries (Quinyon Mitchell, Dallas Goedert, Lane Johnson and Jordan Mailata), so the prior tracker value of 50 represented batch-entry progress rather than 50 unique players. This batch locks the six previously unreferenced active players and brings unique active-roster coverage to 52 of 52.
verification.rosterCrossCheck: All six players are present in PHI/roster.json and their current official Eagles player pages were verified for this batch. Current numbers are Steen 56, Trotter 54, Underwood 41, Wicks 13, Woolen 2 and Young 94. Numbers must be rechecked again at final render time.
verification.appearanceSafety: A reference lock establishes the current official team headshot as source of truth. No skin tone, hair, facial-hair or facial-feature value is guessed or encoded from a name, nickname, biography, heritage, position, or prior-team image.
verification.signatureSafety: No named player-specific celebration is asserted by this batch. Signature research remains a later phase and requires a verifiable source.
